findings.evidence: `rg -n "preimage_const_add_smul_ball"` → hits only at Ball.lean:61 and its own proof at :64; the sole cross-file use is `preimage_smul_vadd_ball_norm` at Harmonic/Ball.lean:50. `Real.norm_eq_abs` is `@[simp]` at mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Group/Real.lean:55-56, so `|c|` is normal form while Harmonic/Ball.lean:49 states `‖c‖ * r`.
findings.fix: Either drop the specialization and let the torsor form plus that bridge be the sole surface, or make it actually usable — state it and the harmonic radius consistently (`|c| * r`, the simp normal form) and consume it at `Harmonic/Ball.lean:50`; if kept, add the matching real-scalar `closedBall`/`sphere` forms so mean-value consumers on `Metric.sphere x r` are not left with only the `+ᵥ` shape.
findings.issue: `preimage_const_add_smul_ball` is exposed `@[simp]` with no consumer in the repo (`rg` finds only its own definition), and it cannot serve its natural call site: it states radius `|c| * r` while `harmonicOnNhd_comp_const_add_smul_ball_radius_iff` states `‖c‖ * r`, so `Harmonic/Ball.lean:50-52` reaches past it to the torsor form and pays a `simpa only [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]` bridge instead.

summary: The torsor-level preimage API is the right characteristic form and the prior membership finding is withdrawn. But the real-scalar specialization `preimage_const_add_smul_ball` is public, `@[simp]`, and has zero consumers — orphaned by this PR, and unusable at its natural call site because of a `|c|` vs `‖c‖` radius mismatch.
